title: Bank group sues U.S. regulator over granting crypto trust charters
reason: Named banking group suing the OCC over crypto trust charters is a significant regulatory fight with clear parties.

sources.summary: The Independent Community Bankers of America sued the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency, accusing the regulator of overstepping its legal authority.

title: BNY in talks with Kraken parent Payward over infrastructure partnership
reason: Talks between BNY and Kraken's parent over custody and payments infrastructure would be a major TradFi-crypto integration if confirmed.

sources.summary: The potential agreement could span digital assets, custody, trading, payments and other financial-market infrastructure.
